kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنفقع (form VII)
# أَنْفَقِعُ (ʔanfaqiʕu) /ʔan.fa.qi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# أَنْفَقِعَ (ʔanfaqiʕa) /ʔan.fa.qi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# أَنْفَقِعْ (ʔanfaqiʕ) /ʔan.fa.qiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
